name: SupportOps Coze-style Workflow Prototype
schema_note: This is a project-local prototype schema for explaining a Coze-style workflow. It is not an official Coze export format.

nodes.description: Receive the support ticket text or incident question from the user.
Select the support workflow or skill based on the predicted intent.
Retrieve relevant FAQ, SOP, troubleshooting, policy, and error-code documents.
Represent graph evidence lookup for relationships among users, teams, projects, tickets, services, error codes, and documents.
Represent mocked plugin or tool calls such as search_error_logs, get_invoice, or create_ticket.
Branch to answer, refusal, or escalation according to evidence sufficiency and safety boundary checks.
Return a grounded support answer with citations, or a refusal/escalation response.
Log the selected route, retrieved documents, graph evidence, mock tool call, decision, and response.
